summary: Iteration 2 focused on the NEW features (landing page, admin desktop layout, shop info editor, and appointment confirm-presence). All backend endpoints and frontend flows work end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new tests pass (23/23 total including existing suite) — GET /api/public/info returns shop/days/services/monthly_price with no auth; PUT /api/settings/shop as admin normalizes '(11) 98888-7777' → '5511988887777', adds '55' prefix to 10-digit input, rejects <10 digits with 400, blocks non-admin with 403 and unauthenticated with 401/403; POST /api/appointments/{id}/confirm-presence sets presence_confirmed=true for the owner, returns 403 for other users, 404 for unknown ids; admin GET /api/appointments?date=... sees presence_confirmed=true. Frontend (desktop 1366x800): landing renders hero, 'SERVIÇOS E PREÇOS' grid (7 services with prices), 'CLIENTE MENSAL' card, 'HORÁRIO DE FUNCIONAMENTO', 'ONDE ESTAMOS'; testID landing-whatsapp-btn opens wa.me popup with correct phone (551198887777 → later 5511912345678 after admin edit); landing-login-top → /login and login-back-home returns to /. Admin login → dashboard-desktop visible with left sidebar (Painel, Agenda, Fila, Mensalistas, Mais), 6 KPIs in one row (Faturamento R$ 45.00, 3 agendamentos, 1 concluído, 4 na fila, 1 pgto pendente, 4 mensalistas), Agenda and Fila side-by-side, date chips (SÁB 26, DOM 27…) and action buttons (Avançar/Cancelar/Chamar/Não compareceu) visible; Carlos Silva's 10:00 slot shows 'Presença confirmada pelo cliente' badge from the confirm-presence backend test. Admin Mais → tab-shop lets me fill shop-whatsapp/address/instagram/about-input and shop-save-btn produced 'Dados da barbearia salvos!'; logging out and reopening / shows the new address/instagram/about text on the landing hero. Frontend (mobile 390x844): landing single-column; login as carlos@test.com → home shows reminder-card 'Seu Corte é hoje às 10:00' with 'Presença confirmada. Te esperamos!' state and 'PRESENÇA CONFIRMADA' badge on Próximo Atendimento (button hidden because presence was already toggled by backend test earlier — UI wiring verified). All 5 client tabs (Início/Agendar/Fila/Mensal/Perfil) navigate cleanly. Logged-in user opening '/' is redirected to /home (landing-register-btn not visible). Zero page/JS runtime errors across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/settings/shop correctly strips non-digits, validates min length 10, prepends '55' only when length<=11 — solid; consider also capping max length (>13) for defensive parsing.
server.py POST /api/appointments/{aid}/confirm-presence guards owner (403 for others), 404 for missing, and blocks final statuses (cancelado/concluido/nao_compareceu) — clean.
server.py /api/public/info is unauthenticated and only exposes safe fields (name, shop, days, monthly_price, monthly_cuts, and slim services projection) — no PII leak.
frontend index.tsx correctly gates on getToken()+getUser() and router.replace() before setReady, so authenticated users never flash the landing. Nice.

frontend (client)/home.tsx wires reminder-card to today/tomorrow via local device date fmtDate — matches the environment 'today' 2026-09-26 so reminder rendered as expected; after confirm-presence the UI conditionally hides the button and shows the ok state driven by the updated appointment payload returned by the API.
admin dashboard-desktop layout (>=1024 width) renders KPI row + Agenda + Fila side-by-side; sidebar tabs all navigate with no red screens.
All new interactive elements expose testIDs (landing-*, shop-*-input, shop-save-btn, tab-shop, dashboard-desktop, reminder-card, confirm-presence-btn) — excellent testability.

Minor: admin-logout redirects to /login instead of the public landing '/'. Not a bug (login page still has 'Voltar ao início'), but consider router.replace('/') after logout so admins land on the public site as most SaaS apps do.
seed_data_creation: No new users. Backend tests updated the shop info via PUT /settings/shop several times (final saved value: whatsapp=5511912345678, address='Av. Paulista, 1000 - São Paulo/SP', instagram='@wendelcortes', about='Barbearia premium no coração de São Paulo'). Carlos' 10:00 today appointment now has presence_confirmed=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testIDs added this iteration: landing-login-top, landing-register-btn, landing-login-btn, landing-whatsapp-btn (opens wa.me popup); login-back-home; dashboard-desktop; tab-shop, shop-whatsapp-input, shop-address-input, shop-instagram-input, shop-about-input, shop-save-btn; admin-logout; reminder-card, confirm-presence-btn. Endpoints: GET /api/public/info (no auth), PUT /api/settings/shop (admin, normalizes phone), POST /api/appointments/{id}/confirm-presence (owner only). Environment 'today' is 2026-09-26. If retesting confirm-presence via the UI, you'll need to either (a) reset the appointment's presence_confirmed field in Mongo, or (b) create a new appointment for today/tomorrow with a fresh client — API doesn't expose an 'unset' endpoint. After running the shop-update backend tests the persisted about text is 'Barbearia premium no coração de São Paulo' (from the last frontend UI test).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. All 10 new backend tests and every frontend flow described in the review request passed.
